 Agreed Compliance Measures
I, Isha Khan, hereby declare that:
1. By reason of my position as Director of the Canadian Museum for Human Rights, I am a reporting public office holder subject to the Conflict of Interest Act (Act);
2. I have an ownership interest in Ratana Holdings Ltd., a private corporation, whose assets include an account composed of “controlled assets” as defined in section 20 of the Act (controlled asset);
3. I agreed to place all of my shares of Ratana Holdings Ltd. in a blind trust (my blind trust);
4. This declaration is a preventive compliance measure, agreed upon pursuant to section 29 of the Act by a public office holder and the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, to assist the public office holders in avoiding conflicts of interest;
5. The Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and I have agreed that this declaration is an appropriate compliance measure for me, aimed at preventing any opportunity, while I exercise my official powers, duties and functions as a reporting public office holder, to further my private interests by giving instructions or receiving consultations with the directors or the trustee of my corporation, Ratana Holdings Ltd.;
6. In order to comply with the requirements of the Act, the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner determined that the following additional compliance measures are required:
